allow: Bash(for playbook in hello-world kafka-k8s-setup postgresql-k8s-setup fastapi-dapr-service)

Bash(powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .specify/scripts/powershell/create-new-feature.ps1 -Json -Number 1 -ShortName "caps-compiler-guide" "CAPS-to-Skills Compiler implementation and usage documentation guide")

Bash(powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "
$featureDir = ''specs/001-caps-compiler-guide''
$phrDir = ''history/prompts/caps-compiler-guide''
if \(!\(Test-Path $phrDir\)\) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $phrDir | Out-Null }
$files = Get-ChildItem -Path $phrDir -Filter ''*.prompt.md'' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$nextId = if \($files\) { \($files | ForEach-Object { [int]\($_.Name -replace ''^\\D*\(\\d+\).*'', ''$1''\) } | Measure-Object -Maximum\).Maximum + 1 } else { 1 }
$nextId = ''{0:D3}'' -f $nextId
Write-Output $nextId
")
